title: Caenicola nitritireducens WGS raw reads
description: Caenicola nitritireducens gen nov., sp. nov., an amino-acid-fermenting strain isolated from a municipal anaerobic digester sludge in Marrakech. These are the raw reads used for the whole genome assembly.
center: This work was supported by PHC Toubkal/15/19-32545NB French Moroccan project
samples: MIGS Cultured Bacterial/Archaeal sample from Synergistaceae bacterium
The sampling was carried out Municipal WWTP of Marrakech (Morocco)
The sample was taken in the context of studying the diversity of microbial community in the anaerobic digesters ofWWTP Marrakech.
